label: s32_st_iris_outside
title: Out in the Light
summary: Iris out of the archive, eating lunch at ten past eleven because that is when the room is quiet. Iris was the most-encountered character in the game and had one storylet of her own. Third option rewritten in Milestone 4: it used to be declining the scene. It is now sitting down and deliberately not raising the thing she has just told you, which is a choice about tact rather than about attendance.
